title: Sr. Support Analyst, Mumbai (Giftcity), Information Technology
Escalation Specialist
description:
Handle customer queries via phone, chat \& email and drive each issue toward resolution in a manner that supports customer satisfaction \& customer retention.
   

  

* Communicate effectively with international customers across different regions, ensuring professional and timely resolution of concerns.
* Ensure 2 hr. or less email/Fresh chat response rates.
* Work cross\-functionally as needed to obtain resolution \& customer satisfaction.
* Handle high\-cost order queries separately and consider high\-value, VIP customers.
* Report process issues, identify trends, and recommend improvements.
* Prepare data for most customer queries to develop and maintain FAQs.
* Act as the primary point of contact for internal teams regarding customized product feasibility and production\-related queries.
* Review customer customization requests and provide guidance on product, design, printing, material, sizing, and production feasibility.
* Coordinate with Design, Production, and Product teams to determine whether customer requirements can be fulfilled within production capabilities.
* Recommend alternative solutions, materials, or design modifications when requested specifications are not feasible.
* Support resolution of production\-related escalations impacting order processing, quality, or delivery timelines.
* Maintain and update internal documentation related to customization guidelines, production capabilities, and product limitations.


**Skills**
 What we require (Desired Skills and abilities)
   

  

 Proven experience effectively assisting customers in an international customer service or contact centre environment.
   

  

* Excellent verbal and written English communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with international customers.
* Strong knowledge of customized products, design processes, printing, and production workflows.
* Advanced conflict resolution capabilities.
* Must be detail\-oriented, extremely organized, and possess strong communication, presentation, and excellent customer and internal relationship management skills.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to assess product, design, and production feasibility and provide clear recommendations.
* Fosters a positive team environment and collaboration within and across departments.
* Approachable, cooperative, professional, and a team player.
* Demonstrates an appropriate sense of urgency and adaptability in response to changing business needs.
